promos.note: NEW TO THE PERMANENT-RATE SET this run. Page describes the loan as a 30-year fixed-rate conventional loan with no year-1/year-2 step-up language, so classified permanent-buydown per methodology. However Perry's own page calls this an 'interest rate buydown' without an explicit full-term-fixed disclosure statement (unlike KB Home and Stylecraft, which use unambiguous '30-Year Fixed' framing) -- flagged for one more manual confirmation before treating as fully equivalent to the other three standing permanent promos. Same $50,000/5.49% terms have appeared in recent prior runs classified as temporary-buydown; this is a reclassification based on today's page language, not a newly announced offer.
